fusions.name: Seize and Fling
fusions.desc: Seizes the target and flings it on a gust, which deals 13 damage, knocks it back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Lobbed From the Canopy
fusions.desc: Hurls a boulder that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets. A gust bursts on impact, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Bough to Bough
fusions.desc: A swing that carries you 5 tiles forward and leaves you moving 20% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Knuckle Gallop
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
